review_notes: PubMed-verified (Eur J Pharmacol 2002). A glial purinergic signalling review used for TAS annotations; appropriate as background but not primary evidence for P2X7.

title: Up-regulation of P2X2, P2X4 receptor and ischemic cell death: prevention by P2 antagonists.
review_notes: PubMed-verified (Neuroscience 2003). The abstract reports up-regulation of P2X2 and P2X4, not P2X7, in ischemic neuronal death. Used in GOA as a NAS annotation for P2X7 response to ischemia. Full text not available here, so the annotation is flagged rather than removed, but this reference does not appear to be about P2X7.

title: Pannexin-1 mediates large pore formation and interleukin-1beta release by the ATP-gated P2X7 receptor.
review_notes: PubMed-verified (EMBO J 2006). Assigns the P2X7-triggered dye-uptake pathway to pannexin-1 and shows pannexin-1 is required for caspase-1 processing and interleukin-1 beta release.

title: Involvement of P2X4 and P2Y12 receptors in ATP-induced microglial chemotaxis.
review_notes: PubMed-verified (Glia 2007). The paper is about P2X4 and P2Y12 in microglial chemotaxis; P2X7 is not its subject. It is used in GOA only as a TAS plasma-membrane localisation, which is harmless, but it is a poor choice of reference for this gene.

title: Influence of extracellular monovalent cations on pore and gating properties of P2X7 receptor-operated single-channel currents.
review_notes: PubMed-verified (Biophys J 2007). Single-channel analysis of human P2X7. Cited here on both sides: it supports the cation permeation, and it argues explicitly against dilation of the P2X7 pore itself.

title: Evidence for functional P2X4/P2X7 heteromeric receptors.
review_notes: PubMed-verified (Mol Pharmacol 2007). The P2X4/P2X7 heteromer claim. Correctly cited but the claim is contested - the paper was published with an accompanying commentary and heteromeric assembly has not become consensus.

title: Interleukin-1 beta secretion from cord blood mononuclear cells in vitro involves P2X 7 receptor activation.
review_notes: PubMed-verified (Reprod Sci 2008). P2X7-dependent interleukin-1 beta release from human cord blood mononuclear cells, blocked by oxidised ATP.

title: The P2X7 receptor is a key modulator of aerobic glycolysis.
review_notes: PubMed-verified (Cell Death Dis 2012). Aerobic glycolysis reprogramming by P2X7; largely in transfected HEK293 and tumour lines.

title: A rare functional haplotype of the P2RX4 and P2RX7 genes leads to loss of innate phagocytosis and confers increased risk of age-related macular degeneration.
review_notes: PubMed-verified (FASEB J 2013). P2X7 as a scavenger receptor mediating phagocytosis; used for a plasma-membrane localisation annotation.

title: A proteome-scale map of the human interactome network.
review_notes: PubMed-verified. Large-scale interactome screen supporting a bare protein binding annotation.

title: Anoctamin 6 mediates effects essential for innate immunity downstream of P2X7 receptors in macrophages.
review_notes: PubMed-verified (Nat Commun 2015). Places ANO6/TMEM16F downstream of P2X7 as the actual scramblase; the reason the phospholipid scrambling annotation on P2X7 is kept non-core.

title: Purinergic receptors P2RX4 and P2RX7 in familial multiple sclerosis.
review_notes: PubMed-verified. Used only for a plasma-membrane localisation annotation.

title: Full-Length P2X(7) Structures Reveal How Palmitoylation Prevents Channel Desensitization.
review_notes: PubMed-verified (Cell 2019). Full-length rat P2X7 cryo-EM structures in apo and ATP-bound states; establishes the trimer, the palmitoylated C-cys anchor and the cytoplasmic ballast.

title: A reference map of the human binary protein interactome.
review_notes: PubMed-verified. Large-scale binary interactome map supporting bare protein binding annotations.

title: Opposing effects of the purinergic P2X7 receptor on seizures in neurons and microglia in male mice.
review_notes: PubMed-verified (Brain Behav Immun 2024). Cell-type-specific P2rx7 deletion in microglia versus neurons gives opposite seizure phenotypes, and human single-cell data show P2RX7 in hippocampal neurons in temporal lobe epilepsy. The strongest positive evidence for neuronal P2X7. See the corrigendum, PMID:40713463.

title: Corrigendum to "Opposing effects of the purinergic P2X7 receptor on seizures in neurons and microglia in male mice" [Brain Behav. Immun. 120 (2024) 121-140].
review_notes: PubMed-verified as an Erratum record for Brain Behav Immun 2024;120:121-140 (PMID:38777288), published Brain Behav Immun 2025;129:1040, doi 10.1016/j.bbi.2025.07.009. The content of the correction could not be retrieved: PubMed and Europe PMC hold no abstract for corrigenda, Europe PMC records it as subscription-only, and both the DOI resolver and ScienceDirect returned no text (403). It is therefore NOT known here what was corrected. Flagged so that a curator relying on PMID:38777288 for neuronal P2X7 checks the corrigendum before citing it.

title: The neuronal P2X7R controversy: Revisiting evidence, methods, and unresolved questions.
review_notes: PubMed-verified (Neuropharmacology 2026, Kachappilly, Pizzo and Basso). Abstract-only in the cache. A dedicated critical review of the neuronal P2X7 question; the source for treating neuronal localisation and neuronal process terms as contested. Note what it does not say - it does not question the molecular function.

title: P2X7 receptor or TNAP genetic blockade prevents the reduction of neuronal CTCF detected in tauopathy.
review_notes: PubMed-verified (Neuropharmacology 2026). Also treats neuronal P2X7R as established, in a tauopathy model. Cited to show that the 2026 literature is not uniform - the same journal published both this and the controversy review.

title: SETDB1 modulates neuroinflammation in the mouse cortex by regulating neuronal P2rx7 expression.
review_notes: PubMed-verified (Mol Psychiatry 2026). Treats neuronal P2rx7 as established: identifies a SETDB1-silenced enhancer in the P2rx7 first intron and shows that P2rx7 ablation partially rescues the neuroinflammatory phenotype of excitatory-neuron Setdb1 knockout.

title: The permeabilizing ATP receptor, P2X7. Cloning and expression of a human cDNA.
review_notes: PubMed-verified (J Biol Chem 1997). Cloning and whole-cell recording of the human P2X7 receptor; the founding experimental basis for the core molecular function and for the permeabilisation phenotype.

title: P2X1-mediated entry of Ca++ from plasma
review_notes: This Reactome event is titled "P2X1-mediated entry of Ca++ from plasma" yet is used as a TAS source for a P2RX7 plasma-membrane annotation. The localisation it supports is correct, but the event describes a different P2X subtype.

title: Gros1, a potential growth suppressor on chromosome 1: its identity to basement membrane-associated proteoglycan, leprecan.
review_notes: Historical cloning/growth-suppressor paper predating the enzymatic characterization; source of the GO:0008285 NAS annotation and the "growth suppressor 1" synonym. Not relevant to the established collagen prolyl 3-hydroxylase function.

title: Prolyl 3-hydroxylase 1, enzyme characterization and identification of a novel family of enzymes.
review_notes: Founding enzyme characterization of P3H1; supports the dioxygenase MF, collagen binding, protein folding and complex-membership annotations (abstract-only in cache).

title: Prolyl 3-hydroxylase 1 deficiency causes a recessive metabolic bone disorder resembling lethal/severe osteogenesis imperfecta.
review_notes: Establishes the OI8 disease link and supports the bone development, protein folding, secretion regulation and negative regulation of PTM annotations.

title: Large-scale proteomics and phosphoproteomics of urinary exosomes.
review_notes: High-throughput urinary exosome proteomics; source of the extracellular exosome HDA localization, peripheral to the core ER function.

title: Recessive osteogenesis imperfecta caused by LEPRE1 mutations: clinical documentation and identification of the splice form responsible for prolyl 3-hydroxylation.
review_notes: Supports the EXP ER localization and the functional relevance of the KDEL ER-retained isoform 1.

title: Prolyl 3-hydroxylase 1 and CRTAP are mutually stabilizing in the endoplasmic reticulum collagen prolyl 3-hydroxylation complex.
review_notes: Supports the protein stabilization annotation and the ER complex/chaperone role; full text available in cache.

title: Defining the membrane proteome of NK cells.
review_notes: High-throughput NK-cell membrane proteome; source of the generic "membrane" HDA localization, likely a co-fractionation capture for this soluble ER-lumenal protein.

title: Lack of cyclophilin B in osteogenesis imperfecta with normal collagen folding.
review_notes: Cyclophilin B OI paper; cited for P3H1 ER localization and complex context.

title: A novel mutation in LEPRE1 that eliminates only the KDEL ER- retrieval sequence causes non-lethal osteogenesis imperfecta.
review_notes: Supports the ER-retention requirement and the protein stabilization, bone development and negative-regulation-of-PTM annotations; full text available.

title: Comprehensive proteomic characterization of stem cell-derived extracellular matrices.
review_notes: High-throughput ECM proteomics; source of the extracellular matrix colocalizes_with HDA annotation, consistent with the secreted proteoglycan form.

title: Histone Interaction Landscapes Visualized by Crosslinking Mass Spectrometry in Intact Cell Nuclei.
review_notes: High-throughput crosslinking MS; source of a P3H1-CRTAP (O75718) IPI protein binding annotation. Partner is a real complex member; bare protein binding uninformative.

title: Cellular stress due to impairment of collagen prolyl hydroxylation complex is rescued by the chaperone 4-phenylbutyrate.
review_notes: PubMed-verified (DOI 10.1242/dmm.038521). Recessive-OI cohort spanning CRTAP/P3H1/PPIB complex defects; documents the downstream ER-stress/UPR/apoptosis pathophysiology and 4-PBA rescue. Supports the cellular consequences of P3H1 loss-of-function (collagen overmodification, ER proteostasis) but is a complex-level/disease-mechanism study, not a P3H1-specific catalytic study. Not cached; no verbatim supporting_text added.

title: Dual proteome-scale networks reveal cell-specific remodeling of the human interactome.
review_notes: BioPlex proteome-scale interactome; source of a P3H1-CRTAP (O75718) IPI protein binding annotation. Partner real; bare term uninformative.

title: Clinical spectrum of rare bone fragility disorders and response to bisphosphonate treatment: a retrospective study.
review_notes: PubMed-verified (DOI 10.1038/s41431-024-01645-4). Clinical/therapeutic cohort that includes P3H1-variant patients among several rare-OI genotypes; relevant to the OI8 disease association and management, not to the molecular function. Not cached; no verbatim supporting_text added.

title: The structural basis for the collagen processing by human P3H1/CRTAP/PPIB ternary complex.
review_notes: Definitive structural/biochemical study; establishes the PCP complex architecture, the catalytic activity (EC 1.14.11.7 assigned), and the CRTAP/PPIB interactions.

title: LEPREL1, a novel ER and Golgi resident member of the Leprecan family.
review_notes: PubMed-verified original characterization of LEPREL1 (P3H2); establishes ER/Golgi localization and domain architecture. Abstract-only cache.

title: Characterization of recombinant human prolyl 3-hydroxylase isoenzyme 2, an enzyme modifying the basement membrane collagen IV.
review_notes: PubMed-verified; the definitive enzymatic characterization underpinning the IDA molecular-function and process annotations and EC 1.14.11.7. Abstract-only cache.

title: The prolyl 3-hydroxylases P3H2 and P3H3 are novel targets for epigenetic silencing in breast cancer.
review_notes: PubMed-verified, full text available; supports the GO:0008285 IDA. The anti-proliferative effect is an indirect/context-dependent phenotype, not the core enzymatic function.

title: Post-translational modification of type IV collagen with 3-hydroxyproline affects its interactions with glycoprotein VI and nidogens 1 and 2.
review_notes: PubMed-verified (DOI 10.1074/jbc.RA117.000406). Direct P3H2 KO study confirming P3H2 as the principal collagen IV 3-hydroxylase and linking the 3-Hyp mark to collagen IV interaction partners (GP6, nidogens). Supports the collagen IV substrate specificity and basement-membrane biological role. Not cached; no verbatim supporting_text added.

title: Prolyl 3-Hydroxylase 2 Is a Molecular Player of Angiogenesis.
review_notes: PubMed-verified (DOI 10.3390/ijms22083896). Implicates P3H2 in VEGF-driven endothelial basement-membrane (collagen IV) remodeling and angiogenesis; a context-dependent physiological role downstream of the core collagen IV-modifying activity. Not cached; no verbatim supporting_text added.

title: Loss of the collagen IV modifier prolyl 3-hydroxylase 2 causes thin basement membrane nephropathy.
review_notes: PubMed-verified (DOI 10.1172/JCI147253). First identification of P3H2 as a GBM modifier; in vivo confirmation of collagen IV as the physiological substrate and a new renal disease association (TBMN/FSGS) complementing the ocular (MCVD high myopia) phenotype. Not cached; no verbatim supporting_text added.

title: Huntingtin interacting proteins are genetic modifiers of neurodegeneration.
review_notes: High-throughput huntingtin-fragment interactome (Y2H + pull-down/MS); source of the IntAct P4HA1-HTT (P13674-P42858) protein binding annotation. Not relevant to the collagen-hydroxylase function.

title: Defining the membrane proteome of NK cells.
review_notes: Membrane-fraction proteomics of NK-like YTS cells; basis of the membrane HDA annotation. P4HA1 is a soluble ER-lumenal protein, so this is a likely co-fractionation artifact (the paper notes many hits are only transiently membrane-associated).

title: The structural motifs for substrate binding and dimerization of the α subunit of collagen prolyl 4-hydroxylase.
review_notes: Structural study establishing the alpha-subunit domain organization, the alpha-alpha dimerization motif (basis of the identical protein binding annotation), and the substrate-binding mode.

title: Molecular cloning of the alpha-subunit of human prolyl 4-hydroxylase: the complete cDNA-derived amino acid sequence and evidence for alternative splicing of RNA transcripts.
review_notes: Foundational cloning/characterization of the human P4HA1 alpha subunit; supports the catalytic activity (TAS), ER localization (via beta/PDI retention), and alternative splicing.

title: Histone Interaction Landscapes Visualized by Crosslinking Mass Spectrometry in Intact Cell Nuclei.
review_notes: Nuclear XL-MS interactome screen; source of an IntAct P4HA1 protein binding annotation (partner paralog P4HA2). Uninformative for the core function.

title: Mannose Binding Lectin Is Hydroxylated by Collagen Prolyl-4-hydroxylase and Inhibited by Some PHD Inhibitors.
review_notes: PubMed-verified (Bhute et al., Kidney360 2020). Identifies a non-collagen C-P4H substrate beyond fibrillar procollagen: mannose-binding lectin (MBL), whose collagen-like domain is prolyl-hydroxylated by collagen prolyl-4-hydroxylase (P4HA1-dependent; secretion of high-MW MBL oligomers requires hydroxylation). Also shows that clinical HIF-PHD inhibitors roxadustat and vadadustat (but not molidustat) suppress MBL hydroxylation as an off-target effect on C-P4H. Expands the documented substrate scope and gives clinical/pharmacological context not in the prior review.

title: P4HA1 expression and function in esophageal squamous cell carcinoma.
review_notes: PubMed-verified (Gou et al., Medicine 2023; DOI 10.1097/MD.0000000000036800). Clinical IHC/TCGA study reporting P4HA1 overexpression in ESCC (high in 68.7% of cases, negative in adjacent tissue) and P4HA1 as an independent prognostic factor (OS/PFS). Cancer-biomarker/prognostic context; not core to the catalytic collagen-hydroxylase function.

title: Lactate supports cell-autonomous ECM production to sustain metastatic behavior in prostate cancer.
review_notes: PubMed-verified (Ippolito et al., EMBO Rep 2024). Provides direct mechanistic evidence that metabolic supply of alpha-ketoglutarate (from CAF-derived lactate) increases P4HA1-dependent collagen 4-hydroxylation (hydroxyproline content), driving a collagen-DDR1 signaling loop that supports prostate cancer metastasis. Illustrates metabolite (2-oxoglutarate) availability as a functional lever on P4HA1 enzymatic output; contextual/non-core for the catalytic annotation but informative for the hypoxia/metabolism-ECM axis.

title: Collagen prolyl 4-hydroxylase subunit alpha member-induced head and neck squamous cell carcinoma aggressiveness is antagonized by LLGL2 via reduced expression of occludin.
review_notes: PubMed-verified (Xu et al., Acta Biochim Biophys Sin 2024; DOI 10.3724/abbs.2024140). TCGA-based analysis of all three C-P4HA alpha subunits (P4HA1/2/3) in HNSCC; higher combined expression of the three is a prognostic indicator, antagonized by LLGL2 via occludin. Family-level cancer context; not core to P4HA1 catalytic function.

title: IL-10 mediates pleural remodeling in systemic lupus erythematosus.
review_notes: PubMed-verified (Niu et al., Cell Commun Signal 2024; DOI 10.1186/s12964-024-01911-4). Places P4HA1 as a downstream effector in an IL-10/JAK2/STAT3/HIF1alpha/TMEM45A/P4HA1 axis driving fibro-inflammatory pleural remodeling/collagen deposition; P4HA1 knockdown blocks IL-10-induced ECM markers. Fibro-inflammatory ECM-remodeling context (non-core); illustrates HIF/hypoxia-linked transcriptional induction of P4HA1.

title: P4HA1: an important target for treating fibrosis related diseases and cancer.
review_notes: PubMed-verified (Yang et al., Front Pharmacol 2024; DOI 10.3389/fphar.2024.1493420). P4HA1-focused review compiling its role across fibrosis-related diseases and cancers, hypoxia/HIF-linked induction, ECM remodeling, and therapeutic-targeting strategies (siRNA, small-molecule P4H inhibitors). Useful map of reported (non-core) disease mechanisms rather than primary evidence.

title: Multimodal cell maps as a foundation for structural and functional genomics.
review_notes: Proteome-scale AP-MS/immunofluorescence cell map in U2OS cells; source of an IntAct P4HA1 protein binding annotation (partner paralog P4HA2). High-throughput, uninformative for the core function.

title: Cloning of the human prolyl 4-hydroxylase alpha subunit isoform alpha(II) and characterization of the type II enzyme tetramer. The alpha(I) and alpha(II) subunits do not form a mixed alpha(I)alpha(II)beta2 tetramer.
review_notes: Direct biochemical characterization of the human prolyl 4-hydroxylase tetramer; primary IDA support for procollagen-proline 4-dioxygenase activity (EC 1.14.11.2) and the alpha2-beta2 subunit composition with P4HB.

title: Histone Interaction Landscapes Visualized by Crosslinking Mass Spectrometry in Intact Cell Nuclei.
review_notes: PubMed-verified crosslinking-MS study; source of IntAct protein binding captures with P4HB and P4HA1. Not focused on P4HA2 function.

title: Prolyl and lysyl hydroxylases in collagen synthesis.
review_notes: PubMed-verified authoritative review (Salo & Myllyharju, Exp Dermatol 2021). Comprehensive review of collagen prolyl 4-hydroxylases (including P4HA1/2/3), 3-hydroxylases and lysyl hydroxylases, covering enzymology, the alpha2-beta2/PDI tetramer, ER localization, biological function and disease. Supports the core enzymatic/complex/localization framing of P4HA2; also notes no collagen-hydroxylase inhibitor is yet in clinical use (in contrast to HIF-PHD inhibitors).

title: Dual proteome-scale networks reveal cell-specific remodeling of the human interactome.
review_notes: PubMed-verified BioPlex interactome; source of protein binding captures (P4HB, KIF7). High-throughput, not P4HA2-specific.

title: OpenCell: Endogenous tagging for the cartography of human cellular organization.
review_notes: PubMed-verified OpenCell interactome; source of the P4HA2-KIF7 protein binding capture. High-throughput, not P4HA2-specific.

title: P4HA2 activates mTOR via hydroxylation and targeting P4HA2-mTOR inhibits lung adenocarcinoma cell growth.
review_notes: PubMed-verified (Jin et al., Oncogene 2024). Reports a non-canonical, non-collagen substrate for P4HA2: it binds mTOR directly and hydroxylates the conserved Pro2341 in the mTOR kinase domain, activating mTOR kinase, increasing mTOR stability/substrate recognition and downstream S6K/AKT signaling; a non-hydroxylatable mTOR P2341A mutant reduces lung adenocarcinoma growth. Suggests a cytoplasmic/extra-ER signaling role distinct from the canonical ER-lumenal collagen-hydroxylase function. Notable new mechanism not in the prior review; not elevated to a core annotation here pending independent confirmation.

title: P4HA2 promotes tumor progression and is transcriptionally regulated by SP1 in colorectal cancer.
review_notes: PubMed-verified (Dang et al., Cancer Biol Ther 2024; DOI 10.1080/15384047.2024.2361594). Provides promoter-level mechanistic evidence that the transcription factor SP1 binds the P4HA2 promoter (ChIP) and activates its transcription in colorectal cancer; P4HA2 overexpression promotes proliferation and EMT, with AGO1 implicated as a downstream effector. Upstream transcriptional-regulation context (non-core for the catalytic annotation) that complements the hypoxia/HIF induction axis.

title: P4HA2 hydroxylates SUFU to regulate the paracrine Hedgehog signaling and promote B-cell lymphoma progression.
review_notes: PubMed-verified (Li et al., Leukemia 2024). Reports a second non-canonical P4HA2 substrate: upon Hedgehog activation P4HA2 forms a complex with KIF7, relocalizes to the primary cilium tip, and hydroxylates SUFU, inhibiting SUFU and amplifying Hedgehog signaling; P4HA2 loss impedes B-cell lymphoma progression. Provides a biological rationale for the otherwise-uninformative high-throughput P4HA2-KIF7 interactome captures (PMID:33961781, PMID:35271311, PMID:40205054). New mechanism not in the prior review; non-core pending independent confirmation.

title: Multimodal cell maps as a foundation for structural and functional genomics.
review_notes: PubMed-verified multimodal cell-maps interactome; source of protein binding captures (P4HB, P4HA1, KIF7). High-throughput, not P4HA2-specific.

title: Enhanced Collagen Prolyl 4-Hydroxylase Activity and Expression Promote Cancer Progression via Both Canonical and Non-Canonical Mechanisms.
review_notes: PubMed-verified review (Hironaka & Xiong, Int J Mol Sci 2025; DOI 10.3390/ijms26199371). Reviews C-P4H structure/function, the alpha2-beta2/PDI tetramer, ER localization, Fe(II)/2-oxoglutarate/O2/ascorbate chemistry, and both canonical (collagen deposition) and non-canonical (signaling-protein hydroxylation, stemness, hypoxia, metabolism) cancer mechanisms of the C-P4HA alpha subunits. Family-level/secondary review context corroborating the core enzymology and the emerging non-canonical-substrate findings (mTOR/SUFU); not primary evidence.

title: Cloning of the human prolyl 4-hydroxylase alpha subunit isoform alpha(II) and characterization of the type II enzyme tetramer. The alpha(I) and alpha(II) subunits do not form a mixed alpha(I)alpha(II)beta2 tetramer.
review_notes: Definitive characterization of human P4HA2; establishes the catalytic activity, cofactors and the alpha2-beta2 tetramer with P4HB. Anchors the IDA/TAS activity annotations.

title: Identification and characterization of a third human, rat, and mouse collagen prolyl 4-hydroxylase isoenzyme.
review_notes: Founding biochemical characterization of P4HA3. Cache is abstract-only, but the core MF (procollagen-proline 4-dioxygenase activity, EC 1.14.11.2 / RHEA:18945) and the alpha2-beta2(PDI) tetramer are directly supported by the abstract and anchor the EXP GOA annotation.

title: A proteome-scale map of the human interactome network.
review_notes: High-throughput binary interactome screen; provides bare protein binding captures only, not informative for P4HA3's catalytic function.

title: Widespread Expansion of Protein Interaction Capabilities by Alternative Splicing.
review_notes: Isoform interactome screen; uninformative bare protein binding for P4HA3.

title: Extensive disruption of protein interactions by genetic variants across the allele frequency spectrum in human populations.
review_notes: Variant-perturbation interactome screen; uninformative bare protein binding.

title: A reference map of the human binary protein interactome.
review_notes: HuRI binary interactome reference map; uninformative bare protein binding for P4HA3's function.

title: Collagen prolyl 4-hydroxylases modify tumor progression.
review_notes: PubMed-verified review (Shi et al., Acta Biochim Biophys Sin 2021; DOI 10.1093/abbs/gmab065). Reviews the three C-P4H isoenzymes (P4HA1/2/3, alpha2-beta2 with single P4HB), their regulation (cytokines, transcription factors, miRNAs), overexpression in tumors, and C-P4H inhibitors as anti-tumor strategies. Supports the core alpha2-beta2/PDI framing and the (non-core) tumor-progression context for P4HA3.

title: P4HA3 promotes clear cell renal cell carcinoma progression via the PI3K/AKT/GSK3beta pathway.
review_notes: PubMed-verified (Zhang et al., Med Oncol 2023; DOI 10.1007/s12032-022-01926-2). P4HA3 is overexpressed in clear cell renal cell carcinoma (TCGA) and high expression correlates with worse overall survival; P4HA3 knockdown inhibits ccRCC cell proliferation, migration and invasion, with GSEA/Western blot implicating EMT and PI3K/AKT/GSK3beta signaling. P4HA3-specific functional-perturbation evidence in a tumor context (non-core for the catalytic annotation).

title: Comprehensive analysis reveals that P4HA3 is a prognostic and diagnostic gastric cancer biomarker that can predict immunotherapy efficacy.
review_notes: PubMed-verified (Yu et al., Sci Rep 2024; DOI 10.1038/s41598-024-73784-z). TCGA/TIMER bioinformatic analysis associating elevated P4HA3 with adverse prognosis and immune-microenvironment features (immune infiltration, TMB, MSI, immune checkpoints) in gastric cancer; proposes P4HA3 as an immunotherapy-response biomarker. Correlative biomarker context, non-core.

title: Collagen prolyl 4-hydroxylase subunit alpha member-induced head and neck squamous cell carcinoma aggressiveness is antagonized by LLGL2 via reduced expression of occludin.
review_notes: PubMed-verified (Xu et al., Acta Biochim Biophys Sin 2024; DOI 10.3724/abbs.2024140). TCGA analysis of all three C-P4HA alpha subunits (including P4HA3) in HNSCC; combined higher expression of the three is prognostically adverse and antagonized by LLGL2 via occludin; knockdown of C-P4HA subunits reduces migration/invasion. Family-level cancer context, non-core for P4HA3.

title: A computational analysis of the oncogenic and anti-tumor immunity role of P4HA3 in human cancers.
review_notes: PubMed-verified (Huang et al., PLoS Comput Biol 2024; DOI 10.1371/journal.pcbi.1012284). Pan-cancer (33 tumor types) analysis with experimental validation: P4HA3 expression correlates with tumor-microenvironment infiltration, proliferation and EMT markers; P4HA3 depletion inhibits proliferation/migration/invasion and enhances anti-tumor PD-1/PD-L1 immunotherapy response (including TNBC PDX models). P4HA3-specific functional evidence in tumor/immune context (non-core for the catalytic annotation).

title: Characterization of the human gene for a polypeptide that acts both as the beta subunit of prolyl 4-hydroxylase and as protein disulfide isomerase.
review_notes: GOA-anchored (this PMID supports GO:0003756 protein disulfide isomerase activity and GO:0004656 procollagen-proline 4-dioxygenase activity in P4HB-goa.tsv); seminal gene-identity paper establishing both PDI catalytic activity and the P4H beta-subunit role - two core functions of P4HB.

title: Phosphorylation switches protein disulfide isomerase activity to maintain proteostasis and attenuate ER stress.
review_notes: GOA-anchored (this PMID supports GO:0003756 protein disulfide isomerase activity and GO:0005783 ER in P4HB-goa.tsv); supports the redox-dependent chaperone/UPR-regulatory (ERN1/IRE1) core function of PDI.

title: Cloning, baculovirus expression, and characterization of a second mouse prolyl 4-hydroxylase alpha-subunit isoform: formation of an alpha 2 beta 2 tetramer with the protein disulfide-isomerase/beta subunit.
review_notes: GOA-anchored (this PMID supports GO:0004656 procollagen-proline 4-dioxygenase activity and GO:0016222 procollagen-proline 4-dioxygenase complex in P4HB-goa.tsv); establishes PDI as the structural beta-subunit of the alpha2beta2 prolyl 4-hydroxylase tetramer - the non-catalytic structural-subunit core function.

title: A human protein-protein interaction network: a resource for annotating the proteome.
review_notes: Large-scale Y2H interactome; supports identical protein binding only as a high-throughput self-interaction, not a specific molecular function.

title: Towards a proteome-scale map of the human protein-protein interaction network.
review_notes: High-throughput interactome dataset; source of generic protein-binding and identical-protein-binding annotations.

title: Octameric structure of the human bifunctional enzyme PAICS in purine biosynthesis.
review_notes: Crystal structure (PDB 2H31); establishes both catalytic activities, the homooctamer, active-site residues, and substrate-channeling tunnels.

title: An empirical framework for binary interactome mapping.
review_notes: High-throughput binary interactome dataset; source of a generic protein-binding annotation.

title: Defining the membrane proteome of NK cells.
review_notes: Membrane-enriched proteome; PAICS detected as an abundant soluble co-isolate, not a genuine membrane protein.

title: MHC class II-associated proteins in B-cell exosomes and potential functional implications for exosome biogenesis.
review_notes: Exosome proteome; PAICS detected as an abundant cytosolic co-isolate, not a functional exosomal protein.

title: Protein interactome reveals converging molecular pathways among autism disorders.
review_notes: High-throughput interactome; source of a generic protein-binding annotation.

title: Toward an understanding of the protein interaction network of the human liver.
review_notes: High-throughput interactome; source of an identical-protein-binding annotation, consistent with homooctamerization.

title: Cloning and sequencing of a human cDNA coding for a multifunctional polypeptide of the purine pathway by complementation of the ade2-101 mutant in Saccharomyces cerevisiae.
review_notes: Original cloning of human PAICS (ADE2); establishes both SAICARS and AIRC activities by homology and yeast complementation.

title: In-depth proteomic analyses of exosomes isolated from expressed prostatic secretions in urine.
review_notes: Exosome proteomics; PAICS detected among ~900 proteins as an abundant co-isolate.

title: A proteome-scale map of the human interactome network.
review_notes: High-throughput interactome; source of protein-binding and identical-protein-binding annotations.

title: E-cadherin interactome complexity and robustness resolved by quantitative proteomics.
review_notes: BioID proximity-biotinylation of E-cadherin tail identifying ~561 vicinal proteins; PAICS proximity is not a genuine cadherin-binding function.

title: Widespread Expansion of Protein Interaction Capabilities by Alternative Splicing.
review_notes: High-throughput interactome; source of a generic protein-binding annotation.

title: CRISPR-Cas9 induced mutations along de novo purine synthesis in HeLa cells result in accumulation of individual enzyme substrates and affect purinosome formation.
review_notes: CRISPR knockouts of DNPS enzymes with substrate accumulation and reduced purinosome assembly; basis for the MGI experimental MF/BP annotations.

title: PAICS deficiency, a new defect of de novo purine synthesis resulting in multiple congenital anomalies and fatal outcome.
review_notes: Human loss-of-function disease (PAICSD); p.Lys53Arg reduces both catalytic activities and prevents purinosome formation.

title: A reference map of the human binary protein interactome.
review_notes: High-throughput binary interactome; source of multiple protein-binding and identical-protein-binding annotations.

title: CAIR + Aspartate + ATP => SAICAR + ADP + Pi
review_notes: Reactome reaction for the SAICAR synthetase step; cytosolic localization.

title: AIR + CO2 => CAIR
review_notes: Reactome reaction for the AIR carboxylase step; cytosolic localization.

title: Control of BRCA2 cellular and clinical functions by a nuclear partner, PALB2.
review_notes: Founding PALB2 paper; establishes BRCA2 binding, nuclear localization, and that PALB2 promotes BRCA2 localization/stability and its HR/checkpoint functions.

title: PALB2 is an integral component of the BRCA complex required for homologous recombination repair.
review_notes: Establishes PALB2 as the direct BRCA1-binding molecular scaffold/adaptor forming the BRCA1-PALB2-BRCA2 complex required for HR.

title: PALB2 regulates recombinational repair through chromatin association and oligomerization.
review_notes: Demonstrates PALB2 chromatin association and coiled-coil-mediated oligomerization anchoring BRCA2·RAD51 at breaks; maps BRCA2 binding to the WD40 repeats.

title: Structural basis for recruitment of BRCA2 by PALB2.
review_notes: Crystal structure of the PALB2 WD40 β-propeller bound to a BRCA2 peptide; defines the BRCA2-recruitment interface.

title: Enhancement of RAD51 recombinase activity by the tumor suppressor PALB2.
review_notes: Biochemical demonstration that PALB2 binds DNA (D-loop > dsDNA > ssDNA), interacts with RAD51, and stimulates RAD51 D-loop formation, cooperating with RAD51AP1.

title: ChAM, a novel motif that mediates PALB2 intrinsic chromatin binding and facilitates DNA repair.
review_notes: Full text confirms PALB2's ChAM motif is necessary and sufficient for intrinsic chromatin association and directly binds nucleosomes (distinct from the DNA-binding regions); ChAM deletion reduces PALB2/RAD51 focus formation and confers mitomycin C hypersensitivity. Basis for the NEW nucleosome-binding (GO:0031491) annotation.

title: PALB2 interacts with KEAP1 to promote NRF2 nuclear accumulation and function.
review_notes: Primary mechanistic paper for PALB2's secondary, HR-independent role; PALB2 uses a conserved ETGE-type motif to compete with NRF2 for KEAP1, promoting NRF2 nuclear accumulation and lowering ROS. Cited to ground the KEAP1 interaction rows that otherwise rest only on high-throughput interactome hits.

title: Breast cancer-associated missense mutants of the PALB2 WD40 domain, which directly binds RAD51C, RAD51 and BRCA2, disrupt DNA repair.
review_notes: Shows the PALB2 WD40 domain directly and independently binds RAD51C, RAD51, BRCA2 and XRCC3, scaffolding an HR complex; breast-cancer missense variants disrupt these interactions and DNA repair.

title: Breast cancer proteins PALB2 and BRCA2 stimulate polymerase η in recombination-associated DNA synthesis at blocked replication forks.
review_notes: PALB2 and BRCA2 interact with POLH and stimulate its DNA synthesis at blocked replication forks; a specialized replication-associated HR role.

title: Non-catalytic Roles for XPG with BRCA1 and BRCA2 in Homologous Recombination and Genome Stability.
review_notes: Places PALB2 in an ERCC5/XPG-BRCA2-PALB2-DSS1-RAD51 HR complex; XPG directly interacts with PALB2, BRCA2 and RAD51.

title: Compromised BRCA1-PALB2 interaction is associated with breast cancer risk.
review_notes: Identifies the PALB2 L35P variant that abrogates BRCA1 binding and HR, confirming the coiled-coil BRCA1-PALB2 bridge and its clinical relevance.

title: Functional and mutational landscapes of BRCA1 for homology-directed repair and therapy resistance.
review_notes: Shows the BRCA1-PALB2 interaction dictates the choice between HR and single-strand annealing.

title: Novel RNA and DNA strand exchange activity of the PALB2 DNA binding domain and its critical role for DNA repair in cells.
review_notes: Maps a major PALB2 DNA-binding site required for RAD51 foci and HDR, and shows the N-DBD has intrinsic strand-exchange activity on DNA and RNA.

title: The strand exchange domain of tumor suppressor PALB2 is intrinsically disordered and promotes oligomerization-dependent DNA compaction.
review_notes: Characterizes the PALB2-DBD as intrinsically disordered; coiled-coil dimerization plus ssDNA-driven tetramerization underlie DNA compaction and strand exchange; frames PALB2 as the BRCA1-BRCA2-RAD51 scaffold.

title: PPARalpha controls the intracellular coenzyme A concentration via regulation of PANK1alpha gene expression.
review_notes: Abstract-only cache (full_text_available: false), but title/abstract verified against PubMed. Directly establishes human PanK1-alpha pantothenate kinase activity, cytoplasmic localization, and PPARalpha-driven regulation of PANK1alpha controlling cellular CoA levels. Basis of the IDA pantothenate kinase activity and cytoplasm annotations.

title: Crystal structures of human pantothenate kinases. Insights into allosteric regulation and mutations linked to a neurodegeneration disorder.
review_notes: Abstract-only cache, but verified against PubMed. Crystal structures of the human PanK1-alpha and PanK3 catalytic cores in complex with acetyl-CoA establish the homodimer, the actin-kinase fold, catalytic activity, and the structural basis of CoA-thioester feedback inhibition. Basis of the acetyl-CoA binding, protein homodimerization, and EXP pantothenate kinase activity annotations.

title: Compartmentalization of mammalian pantothenate kinases.
review_notes: Full text available (PMC3496714). Systematically maps isoform-specific localization: PanK1-alpha nuclear/nucleolar (NLS residues 218-233, matching the UniProt nucleolar localization signal motif), PanK1-beta cytosolic with partial clathrin-coated vesicle and recycling-endosome (Rab11) association. Basis of the nucleus, nucleolus, cytosol, clathrin-coated vesicle, and recycling endosome location annotations.

title: Inherited Disorders of Coenzyme A Biosynthesis: Models, Mechanisms, and Treatments.
review_notes: Full text available (PMC10054636). Review of inherited CoA-biosynthesis disorders describing PanK enzymology; the primary NBIA gene is PANK2 (PKAN), not PANK1. Used by Reactome as the EXP source for pantothenate kinase activity; supports the core enzymatic role but is background/contextual for PANK1 specifically.

title: An isoform of hPANK2, deficient in pantothenate kinase-associated neurodegeneration, localizes to mitochondria.
review_notes: PubMed-verified; establishes the mitochondrial isoform and its relevance to PKAN. Abstract-only cache.

title: Comprehensive proteomic analysis of interphase and mitotic 14-3-3-binding proteins.
review_notes: Correctly cited high-throughput 14-3-3 interactome; supports only a bare protein-binding IPI, with no established functional consequence for PANK2.

title: Altered neuronal mitochondrial coenzyme A synthesis in neurodegeneration with brain iron accumulation caused by abnormal processing, stability, and catalytic activity of mutant pantothenate kinase 2.
review_notes: PubMed-verified; key experimental characterization of human PanK2 processing, localization, and catalytic activity.

title: Biochemical properties of human pantothenate kinase 2 isoforms and mutations linked to pantothenate kinase-associated neurodegeneration.
review_notes: PubMed-verified; primary source for PanK2 kinetics and mutant activity.

title: Activation of human mitochondrial pantothenate kinase 2 by palmitoylcarnitine.
review_notes: PubMed-verified; defines the acetyl-CoA/palmitoylcarnitine regulation of PanK2.

title: Localization and regulation of mouse pantothenate kinase 2.
review_notes: PubMed-verified; establishes the human-vs-mouse localization difference critical for interpreting localization annotations.

title: Metabolic consequences of mitochondrial coenzyme A deficiency in patients with PANK2 mutations.
review_notes: PubMed-verified; full text available. Supports the CoA-biosynthesis role; lipid/triglyceride annotations from this paper are downstream consequences.

title: Compartmentalization of mammalian pantothenate kinases.
review_notes: PubMed-verified; full text available. Definitive submitochondrial and nuclear localization of human PanK2.

title: Silencing of pantothenate kinase 2 reduces endothelial cell angiogenesis.
review_notes: PubMed-verified; supports the (non-core) angiogenesis annotation as a CoA-dependent physiological consequence.

title: Interactome Mapping Provides a Network of Neurodegenerative Disease Proteins and Uncovers Widespread Protein Aggregation in Affected Brains.
review_notes: Correctly cited Y2H interactome; supports only bare protein-binding IPIs without functional interpretation for PANK2.

title: Quantitative high-confidence human mitochondrial proteome and its dynamics in cellular context.
review_notes: PubMed-verified; HTP support for mitochondrial localization.

title: OpenCell: Endogenous tagging for the cartography of human cellular organization.
review_notes: Correctly cited high-throughput interactome/localization resource; supports only a bare protein-binding IPI.

title: Coenzyme A biosynthesis
review_notes: Reactome pathway; supports the core CoA biosynthetic process annotation.

title: PANK2 phosphorylates PanK
review_notes: Reactome reaction; supports the core pantothenate kinase activity and IMS location.

title: Crystal structures of human pantothenate kinases. Insights into allosteric regulation and mutations linked to a neurodegeneration disorder.
review_notes: PubMed-verified structural/biochemical paper on human PanK3 (and PanK1alpha). Establishes homodimer, acetyl-CoA feedback inhibition, and catalytic core. Cited by UniProt for FUNCTION, CATALYTIC ACTIVITY, SUBUNIT, and ACTIVITY REGULATION. Only the abstract is cached (full_text_available: false).

title: Modulation of pantothenate kinase 3 activity by small molecules that interact with the substrate/allosteric regulatory domain.
review_notes: PubMed-verified; crystallography plus enzymology of hPanK3, including pantothenate/ATP kinetics (KM=14 uM pantothenate, KM=311 uM ATP) and S195V/R207A/A267F/A269F mutagenesis abolishing or altering catalysis. Full text cached.

title: Compartmentalization of mammalian pantothenate kinases.
review_notes: PubMed-verified; live-cell imaging of ZsGreen1-tagged isoforms. Directly establishes PanK3 as cytosolic (not nuclear). Full text cached.

title: Allosteric Regulation of Mammalian Pantothenate Kinase.
review_notes: PubMed-verified; defines the catalytic cycle and allosteric mechanism of hPanK3, identifies active site (Glu138), and demonstrates pantothenate (vitamin B5) binding via co-crystal structure. Only the abstract is cached (full_text_available: false).

title: Human pantothenate kinase 4 is a pseudo-pantothenate kinase.
review_notes: PubMed-verified; primarily characterizes PANK4 as a pseudoenzyme, but uses catalytically active HsPANK3 as the reference kinase and directly assays PANK3 pantothenate kinase, ATP-binding, acetyl-CoA-binding, and CoA-biosynthesis activities (E138V abolishes PANK3 activity). Full text cached. Basis for the UniProt EC 2.7.1.33 assignment.

title: A family of metal-dependent phosphatases implicated in metabolite damage-control.
Human pantothenate kinase 4 is a pseudo-pantothenate kinase.
Genomic identification and biochemical characterization of the mammalian polyamine oxidase involved in polyamine back-conversion.
review_notes: Primary paper that genomically identified and biochemically characterized mammalian PAO/PAOX; establishes the diagnostic acetylpolyamine substrate specificity distinguishing PAOX from SMOX. Abstract-only in cache but the substrate ranking and pool-shift data are stated verbatim in the abstract.

title: Guide molecule-driven stereospecific degradation of alpha-methylpolyamines by polyamine oxidase.
review_notes: Enzymology study of PAO substrate stereospecificity; GOA source for several human PAOX IDA annotations. Abstract-only in cache; confirms the natural acetylpolyamine substrates and PAO's role in polyamine catabolism. The "biosynthetic"-direction IDA annotations reflect product formation within the catabolic pathway rather than a dedicated biosynthetic function.

title: Nuclear localization of PAPS synthetase 1: a sulfate activation pathway in the nucleus of eukaryotic cells.
review_notes: PubMed-verified; establishes nuclear localization of PAPSS1. Abstract-only cache.

title: Expression, purification and crystallization of human 3'-phosphoadenosine-5'-phosphosulfate synthetase 1.
review_notes: PubMed-verified; supports homodimer, PAPS synthesis, and both catalytic MFs.

title: Elucidation of the active conformation of the APS-kinase domain of human PAPS synthetase 1.
review_notes: PubMed-verified; structural support for APS kinase activity.

title: Structural mechanism for substrate inhibition of the adenosine 5'-phosphosulfate kinase domain of human 3'-phosphoadenosine 5'-phosphosulfate synthetase 1 and its ramifications for enzyme regulation.
review_notes: PubMed-verified; supports APS kinase activity and its regulation.

title: Human PAPS synthase isoforms are dynamically regulated enzymes with access to nucleus and cytoplasm.
review_notes: PubMed-verified; supports both nuclear and cytosolic localization (IDA source for the localization annotations).

title: Ethanol sulfation by the human cytosolic sulfotransferases: a systematic analysis.
review_notes: PubMed-verified paper, but it studies SULT sulfotransferases and 35S-sulfate labeling; it is a weak/indirect source for the PAPSS1 APS-kinase and PAPS-biosynthesis IDA annotations attributed to it (CAFA-assigned).

title: Dual proteome-scale networks reveal cell-specific remodeling of the human interactome.
review_notes: PubMed-verified high-throughput interactome; supports only an uninformative protein-binding annotation (partner is the paralog PAPSS2).

title: Sulfation in high endothelial venules: cloning and expression of the human PAPS synthetase.
review_notes: PubMed-verified; original cloning and functional characterization of human PAPSS1 (both activities).

title: cDNA cloning, expression, and characterization of the human bifunctional ATP sulfurylase/adenosine 5'-phosphosulfate kinase enzyme.
review_notes: PubMed-verified; supports both catalytic MFs and domain architecture.

title: Molecular cloning, expression, and characterization of human bifunctional 3'-phosphoadenosine 5'-phosphosulfate synthase and its functional domains.
review_notes: PubMed-verified; maps both catalytic activities to defined domains.

title: Mutations in orthologous genes in human spondyloepimetaphyseal dysplasia and the brachymorphic mouse.
review_notes: PubMed-verified, but the paper is about PAPSS2/ATPSK2, not PAPSS1; it does not support a skeletal-development role specific to PAPSS1.

title: Nuclear localization of PAPS synthetase 1: a sulfate activation pathway in the nucleus of eukaryotic cells.
review_notes: PubMed-verified. Abstract-only in cache. Primarily about PAPSS1 nuclear localization but explicitly reports that PAPSS2 is cytoplasmic when expressed alone and relocates to the nucleus upon PAPSS1 co-expression, supporting the cytosol IDA and the conditional nucleus IGI (with/from PAPSS1) annotations.

title: Inactivating PAPSS2 mutations in a patient with premature pubarche.
review_notes: PubMed-verified. Abstract-only in cache. Establishes that PAPSS2 loss-of-function causes androgen excess via impaired DHEA sulfation by SULT2A1, supporting the hormone metabolic process and sulfate assimilation annotations.

title: Human PAPS synthase isoforms are dynamically regulated enzymes with access to nucleus and cytoplasm.
review_notes: PubMed-verified; full text available. Directly documents PAPSS2 as predominantly cytosolic with the capacity to shuttle to the nucleus, supporting the cytosol and nucleus location annotations.

title: Clinical and radiographic features of the autosomal recessive form of brachyolmia caused by PAPSS2 mutations.
review_notes: PubMed-verified. Abstract-only in cache. In vitro enzyme assays of PAPSS2 disease variants support the catalytic-activity (IC) and PAPS biosynthetic process (IMP) annotations.

title: A reference map of the human binary protein interactome.
review_notes: PubMed-verified; high-throughput binary interactome screen. Supports only bare protein binding (HSF2BP, CEP19); uninformative for molecular function.

title: Interactome Mapping Provides a Network of Neurodegenerative Disease Proteins and Uncovers Widespread Protein Aggregation in Affected Brains.
review_notes: PubMed-verified; abstract-only in cache. High-throughput interactome screen supporting only bare protein binding (OPTN); uninformative for molecular function.

title: Dual proteome-scale networks reveal cell-specific remodeling of the human interactome.
review_notes: PubMed-verified; BioPlex AP-MS interactome. Supports only bare protein binding; recorded partner is the paralog PAPSS1, consistent with the known heterodimer but uninformative as a molecular function.

title: Expression and characterization of a human pyruvate carboxylase variant by retroviral gene transfer.
review_notes: PubMed-verified. Experimental characterization of human PC enzyme activity (EXP) including the Type A Ala610Thr disease variant; supports the catalytic-activity annotation.

title: Novel localization of OCTN1, an organic cation/carnitine transporter, to mammalian mitochondria.
review_notes: PubMed-verified. Paper is primarily about OCTN1, not PC; used by MGI as IDA support for PC mitochondrial localization. Cache is abstract-only, so the specific PC supporting data cannot be inspected; deferring to the curator.

title: Crystal structures of human and Staphylococcus aureus pyruvate carboxylase and molecular insights into the carboxyltransfer reaction.
review_notes: PubMed-verified. Crystal structures of human (C-terminal region) and S. aureus PC; establishes homotetramer, Mn(2+) binding and the biotin/BCCP role in the carboxyltransfer reaction.

title: Nonstructural 5A protein of hepatitis C virus interacts with pyruvate carboxylase and modulates viral propagation.
review_notes: PubMed-verified, full text available. Documents the HCV NS5A-PC interaction (via PC biotin carboxylase domain) and that silencing PC reduces infectious-particle production. The derived viral-process and negative-regulation IMP annotations over-state PC's directness (host metabolic dependency; PC is the transcriptional target of NS5A, not the regulator).

title: A hydride transfer complex reprograms NAD metabolism and bypasses senescence.
review_notes: PubMed-verified. Establishes cytosolic PC as a component of the MDH1-ME1-PC hydride transfer complex that reprograms NAD/NADP metabolism in cancer/hypoxic cells. Supports the context-specific cytosolic and NAD(P)-metabolism annotations kept as non-core.

title: Quantitative high-confidence human mitochondrial proteome and its dynamics in cellular context.
review_notes: PubMed-verified. High-confidence mitochondrial proteomics; corroborates PC's mitochondrial localization.

title: Primary amino acid sequence and structure of human pyruvate carboxylase.
review_notes: PubMed-verified. Primary characterization of the human PC cDNA/protein sequence; identifies ATP, pyruvate and biotin-binding sites; highest expression in liver.

title: cDNA cloning of human kidney pyruvate carboxylase.
review_notes: PubMed-verified. cDNA cloning of human PC; identifies the biotin attachment, ATP-binding and pyruvate-binding consensus sequences.

title: Molecular characterization of pyruvate carboxylase deficiency in two consanguineous families.
review_notes: PubMed-verified. Source of UniProt catalytic activity, cofactor and subcellular-location evidence; documents disease-causing mutations with reduced PC activity (IMP support).

title: Automatic transfer of experimentally verified manual GO annotation data to orthologs using Ensembl Compara
review_notes: The Ensembl Compara transfer from mouse Pcbd1 produced an incorrect GO:0004505 (phenylalanine 4-monooxygenase activity) annotation on PCBD1. That activity belongs to PAH, not PCBD1; this is an over-propagation artifact and the resulting annotation is recommended for removal.

title: Towards a proteome-scale map of the human protein-protein interaction network.
review_notes: High-throughput interactome screen; contributes generic protein binding and self-interaction (identical protein binding) annotations. Does not establish a specific PCBD1 molecular function.

title: Characterization of a cofactor that regulates dimerization of a mammalian homeodomain protein.
review_notes: Foundational DCoH paper (Mendel et al., Science 1991). Establishes PCBD1 as the dimerization cofactor of HNF-1alpha that stabilizes HNF1 dimers and enhances transcription without binding DNA. Abstract-only in cache (full_text_available false) but directly supports the coactivator core function.

title: Large-scale proteomics and phosphoproteomics of urinary exosomes.
review_notes: High-throughput urinary exosome proteomics; source of the extracellular exosome localization annotation. Reflects abundance rather than a dedicated extracellular function.

title: A comprehensive resource of interacting protein regions for refining human transcription factor networks.
review_notes: High-throughput interacting-regions dataset; contributes generic protein binding annotations only.

title: An atlas of combinatorial transcriptional regulation in mouse and man.
review_notes: High-throughput interaction atlas; includes an HNF1B interaction but as a generic protein binding annotation.

title: Next-generation sequencing to generate interactome datasets.
review_notes: Methodological interactome dataset; source of an identical protein binding (self-interaction) annotation.

title: Toward an understanding of the protein interaction network of the human liver.
review_notes: High-throughput liver interactome; contributes a generic protein binding annotation (proteasome subunit partner).

title: In-depth proteomic analyses of exosomes isolated from expressed prostatic secretions in urine.
review_notes: High-throughput exosome proteomics; source of an extracellular exosome localization annotation.

title: Mutations in PCBD1 cause hypomagnesemia and renal magnesium wasting.
review_notes: Key functional paper (Ferre et al., JASN 2014; full text available). Experimentally establishes PCBD1 subcellular localization (cytoplasm and nucleus), the HNF1B interaction, and PCBD1 as a coactivator of HNF1B-mediated FXYD2 transcription in the renal DCT, with late complications (hypomagnesemia, MODY) in HPABH4D patients.

title: A proteome-scale map of the human interactome network.
review_notes: High-throughput interactome map; generic protein binding and self-interaction annotations.

title: Widespread Expansion of Protein Interaction Capabilities by Alternative Splicing.
review_notes: High-throughput isoform interactome study; generic protein binding annotation.

title: An interactome perturbation framework prioritizes damaging missense mutations for developmental disorders.
review_notes: High-throughput interactome perturbation study; generic protein binding annotation.

title: Extensive disruption of protein interactions by genetic variants across the allele frequency spectrum in human populations.
review_notes: High-throughput variant-interaction study; generic protein binding annotations.

title: A reference map of the human binary protein interactome.
review_notes: HuRI binary interactome reference map; generic protein binding (including HNF1B) and self-interaction annotations.

title: Dual proteome-scale networks reveal cell-specific remodeling of the human interactome.
review_notes: BioPlex proteome-scale interactome networks; generic protein binding annotations (including HNF1B).

title: Human transcription factor protein interaction networks.
review_notes: Systematic TF interaction network study; recovers the HNF1B interaction relevant to the coactivator role, but annotated only as generic protein binding.

title: 4a-hydroxytetrahydrobiopterin => q-dihydrobiopterin + H2O
review_notes: Reactome reaction for the PCBD1-catalyzed dehydration of 4a-hydroxy-BH4 to quinonoid-dihydrobiopterin in the cytosol; directly supports the core enzymatic function and its cytosolic localization.

title: Genetic heterogeneity in propionic acidemia patients with alpha-subunit defects. Identification of five novel mutations, one of them causing instability of the protein.
review_notes: PubMed-verified; provides experimental mitochondrial import/maturation and PA-causing PCCA variant data. Supports the EXP mitochondrial-matrix annotation.

title: Mitochondrial targeting signals and mature peptides of 3-methylcrotonyl-CoA carboxylase.
review_notes: Focuses on MCC but the abstract explicitly reports the mitochondrial targeting signal and mature N-terminus of propionyl-CoA carboxylase as a paralog; supports the matrix-import IDA for PCCA.

title: N- and C-terminal domains in human holocarboxylase synthetase participate in substrate recognition.
review_notes: Uses the PCCA-derived C-terminal p67 (biotinylation site) as the HLCS substrate; documents the PCCA-HLCS enzyme-substrate interaction underlying the enzyme-binding annotation.

title: Crystal structure of the alpha(6)beta(6) holoenzyme of propionyl-coenzyme A carboxylase.
review_notes: Defines the alpha6-beta6 holoenzyme architecture, BC/BCCP/BT domains of the alpha subunit, and BC active site; the source of the PCCB-interaction and catalytic-complex annotations.

title: Propionyl-CoA carboxylase - A review.
review_notes: Authoritative review of PCC structure, function, mechanism, localization, and disease; primary basis for the description and process/localization judgments.

title: A reference map of the human binary protein interactome.
review_notes: HuRI all-by-all binary interactome; source of a systematic PCCA-MCC(MCCC1) hit reported as bare protein binding. Not informative about core function.

title: Dual proteome-scale networks reveal cell-specific remodeling of the human interactome.
review_notes: Proteome-scale interactome study; source of a PCCA-PCCB protein-binding hit. The interaction (beta subunit) is genuine but the term is uninformative.

title: Isolation of cDNA clones coding for the alpha and beta chains of human propionyl-CoA carboxylase: chromosomal assignments and DNA polymorphisms associated with PCCA and PCCB genes.
review_notes: Identified the PCCA (alpha) cDNA via the conserved biotin-binding-site motif; supports the biotin-binding TAS annotation.

title: Quantitative high-confidence human mitochondrial proteome and its dynamics in cellular context.
review_notes: High-confidence mitochondrial proteome; independent HTP evidence for mitochondrial localization of PCCA.

title: Multimodal cell maps as a foundation for structural and functional genomics.
review_notes: Multimodal cell-map genomics resource; source of a PCCA-PCCB protein-binding hit. Genuine partner, uninformative term.

title: Isolation and characterization of propionyl-CoA carboxylase from normal human liver. Evidence for a protomeric tetramer of nonidentical subunits.
review_notes: Definitive biochemical characterization of purified human PCC: biotin content on the alpha subunit, kinetic parameters for ATP/propionyl-CoA/bicarbonate, substrate range. Primary support for the catalytic-activity, cofactor and ATP-binding core functions.

title: Cloning of functional alpha propionyl CoA carboxylase and correction of enzyme deficiency in pccA fibroblasts.
review_notes: Functional cloning and complementation of PCCA-deficient fibroblasts restoring propionate flux; support for the IMP propionyl-CoA carboxylase and pathway annotations.

title: Characterization of four variant forms of human propionyl-CoA carboxylase expressed in Escherichia coli.
review_notes: Verified against cached abstract; establishes PCC as a biotin-dependent mitochondrial enzyme catalyzing propionyl-CoA to D-methylmalonyl-CoA and characterizes PCCB pathogenic variants (assembly defects). Supports the EXP propionyl-CoA carboxylase activity annotation.

title: Mitochondrial targeting signals and mature peptides of 3-methylcrotonyl-CoA carboxylase.
review_notes: Title foregrounds MCC, but the study explicitly also defines the mitochondrial targeting presequence and mature N-terminus of propionyl-CoA carboxylase and demonstrates matrix import; correct source for the IDA mitochondrial matrix annotation.

title: Crystal structure of the alpha(6)beta(6) holoenzyme of propionyl-coenzyme A carboxylase.
review_notes: Full text available; defines the alpha6-beta6 dodecamer architecture and that the beta subunit supplies the carboxyltransferase activity. Supports subunit composition, complex membership, and MF.

title: Propionyl-CoA carboxylase - A review.
review_notes: Comprehensive review; verified full text supports the reaction, substrate sources (c-VOMIT), matrix localization, holoenzyme composition, and disease links used throughout this review.

title: A reference map of the human binary protein interactome.
review_notes: Large-scale yeast two-hybrid interactome; the PCCB-ACTN3 hit is not biologically corroborated for a mitochondrial matrix enzyme and is most likely a high-throughput artifact. Supports only a bare protein-binding IPI.

title: Dual proteome-scale networks reveal cell-specific remodeling of the human interactome.
review_notes: BioPlex AP-MS interactome; the reported PCCB-PCCA interaction is the genuine obligate partner association but is captured more informatively by the complex and MF annotations than by bare protein binding.

title: Quantitative high-confidence human mitochondrial proteome and its dynamics in cellular context.
review_notes: High-confidence mitochondrial proteome study supporting mitochondrial localization (HTP) of PCCB; concordant with matrix annotations.

title: Multimodal cell maps as a foundation for structural and functional genomics.
review_notes: Multimodal cell-map / AP-MS study; the reported PCCB-PCCA interaction is the genuine partner-subunit association, redundant with the complex/MF annotations. Supports only a bare protein-binding IPI.

title: Isolation and characterization of propionyl-CoA carboxylase from normal human liver. Evidence for a protomeric tetramer of nonidentical subunits.
review_notes: Purified the human enzyme to homogeneity, established alpha/beta subunit composition and biotin content, and measured propionyl-CoA carboxylase kinetics. Primary experimental support for the core MF (IDA) and substrate properties.

title: Correction of the metabolic defect in propionic acidemia fibroblasts by microinjection of a full-length cDNA or RNA transcript encoding the propionyl-CoA carboxylase beta subunit.
review_notes: Cloned full-length human PCCB, demonstrated mitochondrial import and assembly of beta subunits into functional PCC, and corrected the PA fibroblast defect. Basis for the RecName evidence and the TAS mitochondrion annotation.

title: Distribution of CTP:phosphocholine cytidylyltransferase (CCT) isoforms. Identification of a new CCTbeta splice variant.
review_notes: PubMed-verified. Source of the CCTalpha IDA annotations (nucleus, ER, ER membrane, catalytic activity, PC biosynthesis, CDP-choline pathway). Title foregrounds a new CCTbeta2 splice variant, but the alpha-specific nuclear+ER localization and activity are established in the same study; not a mis-attribution.

title: Architecture of the human interactome defines protein communities and disease networks.
review_notes: BioPlex 2.0 proteome-scale AP-MS interactome. Supports only a bare "protein binding" IPI with no CCTalpha-specific function.

title: Disease-linked mutations in the phosphatidylcholine regulatory enzyme CCTα impair enzymatic activity and fold stability.
review_notes: PubMed-verified. Provides the EXP catalytic-activity annotation and biochemical characterization of SMDCRD/CGL5 variants; directly supports the amphitropic-regulation and disease mechanism.

title: A reference map of the human binary protein interactome.
review_notes: HuRI binary (Y2H) interactome map. Source of several bare "protein binding" IPIs and the identical-protein-binding (self-interaction) call; no specific function.

title: Dual proteome-scale networks reveal cell-specific remodeling of the human interactome.
review_notes: BioPlex 3.0 proteome-scale AP-MS interactome. Supports only a bare "protein binding" IPI.

title: Multimodal cell maps as a foundation for structural and functional genomics.
review_notes: Multimodal (AP-MS + immunofluorescence) U2OS cell map. Supports only a bare "protein binding" IPI with no CCTalpha-specific function.

title: Primary structure and expression of a human CTP:phosphocholine cytidylyltransferase.
review_notes: PubMed-verified. Original cloning and functional expression of human CCTalpha; supports the TAS catalytic-activity annotation and lipid-dependent activation.

title: PCho and CTP are condensed to CDP-Cho by PCYT1 dimer
review_notes: Reactome reaction placing the active membrane-bound PCYT1A/B homodimer at the ER membrane; consistent with the human IDA localization and the core reaction.

title: Distribution of CTP:phosphocholine cytidylyltransferase (CCT) isoforms. Identification of a new CCTbeta splice variant.
review_notes: PubMed-verified abstract (full text not cached). Directly supports CCTβ enzymatic activity, ER localization, and isoform characterization for this gene.

title: Cloning and characterization of a second human CTP:phosphocholine cytidylyltransferase.

title: PCho and CTP are condensed to CDP-Cho by PCYT1 dimer

title: Architecture of the human interactome defines protein communities and disease networks.

title: Mutations in PCYT2 disrupt etherlipid biosynthesis and cause a complex hereditary spastic paraplegia.
review_notes: Full-text (PMC6821184) directly establishes PCYT2's rate-limiting catalytic role and disease association; primary support for the IMP MF/BP annotations.

title: A reference map of the human binary protein interactome.
review_notes: HuRI binary (Y2H) interactome; source of a bare protein-binding IPI. Not informative for PCYT2 function.

title: Interactome Mapping Provides a Network of Neurodegenerative Disease Proteins and Uncovers Widespread Protein Aggregation in Affected Brains.
review_notes: Neurodegeneration interactome/aggregation screen; source of a bare protein-binding IPI. Abstract-only cache; does not define a specific PCYT2 function.

title: Dual proteome-scale networks reveal cell-specific remodeling of the human interactome.
review_notes: BioPlex 3.0 proteome-scale AP-MS network; source of a bare protein-binding IPI. Not informative for PCYT2 catalytic function.

title: Cloning of a human cDNA for CTP-phosphoethanolamine cytidylyltransferase by complementation in vivo of a yeast mutant.
